newsitem.title: UK: RUGBY UNION-WELSH PLAYER BANNED SIX YEARS.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-WELSH PLAYER BANNED SIX YEARS.

text.p: A Welsh club player was banned from rugby for six years on Monday after kicking an opponent in the head.

Backrow forward Sean Gibson, playing for Hartridge in a local cup match, had only just returned from another suspension when he kicked Caerleon's Andrew Rice in the head, causing injuries which needed 44 stitches.
Rice, who has now retired from the game, dropped an assault complaint in order to leave disciplinary action to the Welsh Districts Rugby Union.
The match was abandoned after only 20 minutes because of fighting between the two sides.
Hartridge forward Robert Taylor was also banned for 10 weeks for butting a player and fighting with the Caerleon touch judge.
